key: How we doing today? Up for a round?
en: How we doing today? Up for a round?
ja: 今日はどうだ? 一戦いくか?

key: Ask me if I hate this.
en: Ask me if I hate this.
ja: キャメロン: これが嫌いかどうか、聞いてみろよ。

key: I hate this.
en: I hate this.
ja: 大嫌いだ。

key: The angry Tauros attacked!
en: The angry Tauros attacked!
ja: 怒ったケンタロスが攻撃してきた!

key: Bouffalant roars triumphantly!
en: Bouffalant roars triumphantly!
ja: バッフロンが勝ち誇るようにほえた!

key: ...Bouffalant charged blindly away!
en: ...Bouffalant charged blindly away!
ja: ……バッフロンはやみくもに突進して去っていった!

key: ...It sounds like Bouffalant crashed into something!
en: ...It sounds like Bouffalant crashed into something!
ja: ……バッフロンが何かにぶつかった音がした!

key: The angry Bouffalant attacked!
en: The angry Bouffalant attacked!
ja: 怒ったバッフロンが攻撃してきた!

key: Tauros roars triumphantly!
en: Tauros roars triumphantly!
ja: ケンタロスが勝ち誇るようにほえた!

key: Tauros seems thankful and compliant.
en: Tauros seems thankful and compliant.
ja: ケンタロスは、感謝して素直になっているようだ。

key: Do you want to try and ride the Tauros?
en: Do you want to try and ride the Tauros?
ja: ケンタロスに乗ってみますか?

key: Ah, hello again. Have you come to donate a Dunsparce to us?
en: Ah, hello again. Have you come to donate a Dunsparce to us?
ja: ああ、またお会いしましたね。ノコッチを寄付しに来てくれたんですか?

key: The Azurine Observation and Breeding Facility has been beyond tardy in their shipments of Pokémon for reintroduction.
en: The Azurine Observation and Breeding Facility has been beyond tardy in their shipments of Pokémon for reintroduction.
ja: アズリン観測繁殖施設からの、再導入用ポケモンの発送が、ひどく遅れているんです。

key: We were scheduled to re-establish the Dunsparce population last month, but there's been no word from them.
en: We were scheduled to re-establish the Dunsparce population last month, but there's been no word from them.
ja: 先月、ノコッチの個体数を再確立する予定だったのですが、あちらから何の連絡もなくて。

key: It is a poor substitute, but, Trainer, should you encounter any Dunsparce, please consider donating them to us.
en: It is a poor substitute, but, Trainer, should you encounter any Dunsparce, please consider donating them to us.
ja: 代わりにはなりませんが、トレーナーさん、もしノコッチを見つけたら、こちらに寄付していただけないかと。

key: I will offer you a young Pokémon in return. We had planned to reintroduce them to the wild before, but were forced to cancel that operation.
en: I will offer you a young Pokémon in return. We had planned to reintroduce them to the wild before, but were forced to cancel that operation.
ja: お礼に、若いポケモンをお渡しします。以前、野生に再導入する予定だったのですが、その計画は中止せざるを得なくなったものです。

key: I understand.
en: I understand.
ja: わかりました。

key: Wonderful! Let's begin at once.
en: Wonderful! Let's begin at once.
ja: 素晴らしい! さっそく始めましょう。

key: \PN traded Dunsparce for Tyrogue!
en: \PN traded Dunsparce for Tyrogue!
ja: \PNはノコッチとバルキーを交換した!

key: This will be an excellent addition to the populations' re-establishment.
en: This will be an excellent addition to the populations' re-establishment.
ja: 個体数の再確立に、大いに貢献してくれるはずです。

key: In fact, as a small extra thanks, why don't you take this as well?
en: In fact, as a small extra thanks, why don't you take this as well?
ja: それと、ちょっとしたお礼として、これも受け取ってもらえませんか?

key: Some of our old monitoring equipment was deprecated recently, and this was left over.
en: Some of our old monitoring equipment was deprecated recently, and this was left over.
ja: 古い観測機器の一部が最近廃棄されて、これが余ったんです。

key: I hear some Trainers make use of it?
en: I hear some Trainers make use of it?
ja: トレーナーの中には、これを活用する人もいるとか?

key: Please keep us in mind if you find any more Dunsparce!
en: Please keep us in mind if you find any more Dunsparce!
ja: ノコッチを他にも見つけたら、ぜひ私たちのことを思い出してくださいね!

key: The Miltank is calm and wears a collar.
en: The Miltank is calm and wears a collar.
ja: そのミルタンクは落ち着いていて、首輪をつけている。

key: Tauros is staring at the Miltank intensely.
en: Tauros is staring at the Miltank intensely.
ja: ケンタロスが、ミルタンクをじっと見つめている。

key: Miltank-senpai doesn't seem to notice him.
en: Miltank-senpai doesn't seem to notice him.
ja: ミルタンク先輩は、気づいていないようだ。

key: Miltank returns the gaze, becoming lost in Tauros' eyes.
en: Miltank returns the gaze, becoming lost in Tauros' eyes.
ja: ミルタンクが見つめ返し、ケンタロスの瞳に見入っている。

key: You feel that you could cut the sexual tension with a knife.
en: You feel that you could cut the sexual tension with a knife.
ja: この場の艶っぽい緊張感は、ナイフで切れそうなほどだ。

key: Miltank blushes and nuzzles against Tauros. It roars quietly as it breathes down the Miltank's neck.
en: Miltank blushes and nuzzles against Tauros. It roars quietly as it breathes down the Miltank's neck.
ja: ミルタンクがほおを赤らめ、ケンタロスに身を寄せる。ケンタロスはミルタンクの首元に息を吹きかけながら、静かにうなった。

key: You kind of want to dismount now.
en: You kind of want to dismount now.
ja: なんだか、今すぐ降りたい気分になる。

key: Miltank bleats coyly and bows down to the Tauros.
en: Miltank bleats coyly and bows down to the Tauros.
ja: ミルタンクが恥ずかしそうに鳴き、ケンタロスに頭を下げる。

key: You suspect you might be about to witness the live action version of 50 Shades of Bull.
en: You suspect you might be about to witness the live action version of 50 Shades of Bull.
ja: これから「フィフティ・シェイズ・オブ・ブル」の実写版を目撃することになりそうな予感がする。

key: Miltank notices the Oran Berry you hold.
en: Miltank notices the Oran Berry you hold.
ja: ミルタンクが、あなたの持っているオレンのみに気づいた。

key: Do you want to give Miltank the Berry?
en: Do you want to give Miltank the Berry?
ja: ミルタンクにそのみを与えますか?

key: \PN handed over the Oran Berry.
en: \PN handed over the Oran Berry.
ja: \PNはオレンのみを渡した。

key: Miltank is moaning uncomfortably.
en: Miltank is moaning uncomfortably.
ja: ミルタンクが、苦しそうにうめいている。

key: Miltank seems to be incredibly uncomfortable.
en: Miltank seems to be incredibly uncomfortable.
ja: ミルタンクは、ひどく居心地悪そうにしている。

key: Miltank seems to be sleeping.
en: Miltank seems to be sleeping.
ja: ミルタンクは、眠っているようだ。

key: You decide it would be best to not leave the two alone, or else you may have no idea where an Egg came from.
en: You decide it would be best to not leave the two alone, or else you may have no idea where an Egg came from.
ja: この二匹を二人きりにしない方がいいと判断した。さもないと、タマゴがどこから来たのか、わからなくなりそうだ。

key: Miltank and Tauros hold each other's gaze for a moment.
en: Miltank and Tauros hold each other's gaze for a moment.
ja: ミルタンクとケンタロスが、しばらくお互いを見つめ合っている。

key: You suspect that this is the kind of Miltank that brings all the bulls to the yard in daylight.
en: You suspect that this is the kind of Miltank that brings all the bulls to the yard in daylight.
ja: このミルタンク、昼日中から牛たちを庭に呼び寄せるタイプなんじゃないかと思えてくる。

key: Giddy-up!
en: Giddy-up!
ja: それ、進め!

key: Woah, there.
en: Woah, there.
ja: ネリー: おっと、そこまで。

key: You's a fighter, huh.
en: You's a fighter, huh.
ja: あんた、なかなかの戦士だね。

key: HO!
en: HO!
ja: ホウ!

key: Hoo-hah!
en: Hoo-hah!
ja: オルタン: フーハ!

key: Guh... Too much.
en: Guh... Too much.
ja: ぐっ……やりすぎた。

key: Ah, someone else ventured outside the walls. Isn't it better out here?
en: Ah, someone else ventured outside the walls. Isn't it better out here?
ja: ああ、また誰か壁の外に出てきたか。外の方がいいだろう?

key: Your spirit reminds me of someone else.
en: Your spirit reminds me of someone else.
ja: アルミン: お前の気概、誰かを思い出すな。

key: Even if it's more dangerous here, I'd rather take my chances than be caged up within the walls.
en: Even if it's more dangerous here, I'd rather take my chances than be caged up within the walls.
ja: ここの方が危険だとしても、壁の中に閉じ込められてるより、賭けに出る方がマシだ。

key: SANDY: Oh, hey \PN!
en: SANDY: Oh, hey \PN!
ja: サンディ: あ、よお、\PN!

key: It's great to see you again!
en: It's great to see you again!
ja: また会えてうれしいよ!

key: I heard you fell out of existence for a while or something?
en: I heard you fell out of existence for a while or something?
ja: なんか、しばらく存在から消えてたって聞いたけど?

key: I mean, that happens sometimes, no sweat!
en: I mean, that happens sometimes, no sweat!
ja: まあ、そういうこともあるよな、気にすんな!

key: ???: Oh, hello there!
en: ???: Oh, hello there!
ja: ???: あ、こんにちは!

key: Are you the one coming in from the Nightclub?
en: Are you the one coming in from the Nightclub?
ja: ナイトクラブから来た人?

key: That's great! I could really use the help!
en: That's great! I could really use the help!
ja: 助かる! ちょうど手を貸してほしかったんだ!

key: My name's Sandy! I'm an activist for the sake of Pokémon everywhere!
en: My name's Sandy! I'm an activist for the sake of Pokémon everywhere!
ja: オレの名前はサンディ! あらゆるポケモンのために活動してる活動家だ!

key: Anyway, could you help me out here?
en: Anyway, could you help me out here?
ja: とにかく、ここで手伝ってくれないか?

key: This Miltank seems really sick, but for some reason no one in the center wants to do anything about it!
en: This Miltank seems really sick, but for some reason no one in the center wants to do anything about it!
ja: このミルタンク、すごく具合が悪そうなんだけど、なぜかセンターの誰もどうにかしようとしないんだ!

key: I think she just ate too many Oran Berries and needs to be milked...
en: I think she just ate too many Oran Berries and needs to be milked...
ja: オレンのみを食べすぎて、乳搾りが必要なだけだと思うんだけど……

key: Either that or she's pregnant.
en: Either that or she's pregnant.
ja: でなきゃ、妊娠してるかだな。

key: But definitely one of the two!
en: But definitely one of the two!
ja: でも、絶対にどっちかだ!

key: Wait, if Pokémon lay eggs, can they still get pregnant?
en: Wait, if Pokémon lay eggs, can they still get pregnant?
ja: 待てよ、ポケモンってタマゴを産むのに、妊娠もするのか?

key: Can you be pregnant with an egg???
en: Can you be pregnant with an egg???
ja: タマゴで妊娠するってあり得るのか???

key: Eggnant!?!!?
en: Eggnant!?!!?
ja: タマゴ妊娠!?!!?

key: Well, nevermind!
en: Well, nevermind!
ja: まあ、いいや!

key: If we can get Miltank's internal temperature we can probably figure out what's wrong!
en: If we can get Miltank's internal temperature we can probably figure out what's wrong!
ja: ミルタンクの体温を測れれば、何が悪いのかわかるはずだ!

key: I already, uh, "borrowed" a thermometer from inside,
en: I already, uh, "borrowed" a thermometer from inside,
ja: もう、その、中から体温計を「借りて」きたんだけど、

key: And I'm pretty sure I read that the most accurate way to get a reading is through the, uhm, rectum.
en: And I'm pretty sure I read that the most accurate way to get a reading is through the, uhm, rectum.
ja: 一番正確に測る方法は、その、直腸から、って読んだ気がするんだ。

key: The problem is, I've been having trouble getting her to let me check!
en: The problem is, I've been having trouble getting her to let me check!
ja: 問題は、こいつに測らせてもらうのに、ずっと苦労してることでさ!

key: So, here's the plan.
en: So, here's the plan.
ja: それで、こういう計画だ。

key: I'll hold her steady, and you insert the thermometer and get a read, okay?
en: I'll hold her steady, and you insert the thermometer and get a read, okay?
ja: オレがこいつを押さえてるから、お前が体温計を入れて測ってくれ、いいか?

key: No?
en: No?
ja: だめ?

key: ...Oh, right! We were supposed to be checking out the Anomalies reported here!
en: ...Oh, right! We were supposed to be checking out the Anomalies reported here!
ja: ……ああ、そうだ! ここで報告された異常現象を調べるはずだったんだ!

key: Mmmmmm...
en: Mmmmmm...
ja: うーん……

key: I just can't leave this poor creature to suffer like this, though!
en: I just can't leave this poor creature to suffer like this, though!
ja: でも、こんなに苦しんでるかわいそうな生き物を、放っておけないんだよ!

key: I'm going to help it no matter what!
en: I'm going to help it no matter what!
ja: 何としても、こいつを助けるんだ!

key: Can I trust you to look for the Anomalies?
en: Can I trust you to look for the Anomalies?
ja: 異常現象を探すの、任せてもいいか?

key: From what I've gathered, there should be one in the North Aventurine Woods, one in the South Aventurine Woods, and another somewhere else near here.
en: From what I've gathered, there should be one in the North Aventurine Woods, one in the South Aventurine Woods, and another somewhere else near here.
ja: 集めた情報だと、北アベンチュリンの森にひとつ、南アベンチュリンの森にひとつ、それとこの近くのどこかにもうひとつあるはずだ。

key: I'll be here for moral support too!
en: I'll be here for moral support too!
ja: オレもここで精神的サポートするから!

key: Just let me know if you need a reminder!
en: Just let me know if you need a reminder!
ja: 忘れちゃったら、いつでも聞いてくれよな!

key: SANDY: Baby, come on, this is for your own good!
en: SANDY: Baby, come on, this is for your own good!
ja: サンディ: なあ、ベイビー、頼むよ、これはお前のためなんだから!

key: Just let me put it in!!!
en: Just let me put it in!!!
ja: ちょっと入れさせてくれよ!!!

key: Oh, did you want me to remind you where the thingies were?
en: Oh, did you want me to remind you where the thingies were?
ja: ああ、あれがどこにあったか、思い出させてほしいのか?

key: Good luck!
en: Good luck!
ja: 頑張れよ!

key: Wish me luck too... I clearly need it.
en: Wish me luck too... I clearly need it.
ja: オレにも幸運を祈ってくれ……絶対必要だから。

key: SANDY: Ugh, come on, just let me get it--
en: SANDY: Ugh, come on, just let me get it--
ja: サンディ: うう、頼むよ、ちょっと入れさせて――

key: Oh, \PN...
en: Oh, \PN...
ja: あ、\PN……

key: Are you having any luck?
en: Are you having any luck?
ja: そっちはうまくいってるか?

key: I'm sure not...
en: I'm sure not...
ja: こっちは全然だよ……

key: I finally got to check its temperature, but then the thermometer got stuck in there!
en: I finally got to check its temperature, but then the thermometer got stuck in there!
ja: やっと体温は測れたんだけど、そしたら体温計が中で引っかかっちまって!

key: And now she won't let me get it out!!!
en: And now she won't let me get it out!!!
ja: それで、もう抜かせてくれないんだ!!!

key: Anyway, do you need a reminder?
en: Anyway, do you need a reminder?
ja: とにかく、また思い出させようか?

key: Say, do you want to switch jobs?
en: Say, do you want to switch jobs?
ja: なあ、仕事交代しないか?

key: Boo...
en: Boo...
ja: ぶー……

key: The Tauros is absolutely wild!
en: The Tauros is absolutely wild!
ja: このケンタロスは完全に野生だ!

key: ...Do you want to try and ride it?
en: ...Do you want to try and ride it?
ja: ……乗ってみますか?

key: ...The Tauros charged off!
en: ...The Tauros charged off!
ja: ……ケンタロスが突進して去っていった!

key: Got bucked off!
en: Got bucked off!
ja: 振り落とされた!

key: SANDY: Hi, \PN...
en: SANDY: Hi, \PN...
ja: サンディ: よお、\PN……

key: ...Good news!
en: ...Good news!
ja: ……いい知らせだ!

key: The thermometer finally came out of its butt!...
en: The thermometer finally came out of its butt!...
ja: やっと体温計がお尻から出てきたよ!……

key: ...Also, so did what was apparently the Nature Center staff's entire supply of cream puffs...
en: ...Also, so did what was apparently the Nature Center staff's entire supply of cream puffs...
ja: ……それと一緒に、どうやら自然センターのスタッフのシュークリームの在庫、丸ごと出てきた……

key: They let me clean myself up afterwards, but I know why no one wanted to deal with this now...
en: They let me clean myself up afterwards, but I know why no one wanted to deal with this now...
ja: あの後、体を洗わせてもらったんだけど、みんながこれに関わりたがらなかった理由が、今ならわかるよ……

key: \PN, it...
en: \PN, it...
ja: \PN、あれは……

key: It was awful...
en: It was awful...
ja: ひどかった……

key: It was everywhere...
en: It was everywhere...
ja: 至る所に飛び散ってた……
僕は……

key: I need some time...
en: I need some time...
ja: ちょっと時間が必要だ……

key: SANDY: Did...
en: SANDY: Did...
ja: サンディ: 見つ……

key: Did you find them all?
en: Did you find them all?
ja: 全部見つかったか?

key: That's... good.
en: That's... good.
ja: それは……良かった。

key: I'll... just head back now...
en: I'll... just head back now...
ja: オレは……もう戻るよ……

key: Um...
en: Um...
ja: コールマン: ええと……

key: Thanks for your help,
en: Thanks for your help,
ja: 手伝ってくれてありがとな、

key: And, yeah, by 'help,' I mean doing the entire thing for me during my extremely traumatic experience...
en: And, yeah, by 'help,' I mean doing the entire thing for me during my extremely traumatic experience...
ja: ああ、「手伝い」って言うのは、オレがめちゃくちゃトラウマな経験をしてる間に、全部代わりにやってくれたことだけど……

key: I think when I go back to the Nightclub, I'm giving up field work.
en: I think when I go back to the Nightclub, I'm giving up field work.
ja: ナイトクラブに戻ったら、現場仕事はもう辞めようと思う。

key: A desk job sounds great, doesn't it?
en: A desk job sounds great, doesn't it?
ja: デスクワーク、良さそうじゃないか?

key: Inside.
en: Inside.
ja: 屋内で。

key: With the air purifiers.
en: With the air purifiers.
ja: 空気清浄機付きで。

key: And no Miltank ever.
en: And no Miltank ever.
ja: ミルタンクとは二度と関わらない。

key: That sounds... just lovely...
en: That sounds... just lovely...
ja: それって……本当に素敵……

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
